title: [review] messaging.py:80: Public deliver() method lacks validation
description: The deliver() method is documented as public API for mesh-delivered messages ('used when a message arrives over the mesh rather than via CoAP POST') but performs no validation of the message structure. While render_post() validates input, external callers could inject malformed messages directly into the inbox. This is a defense-in-depth gap - if mesh-layer validation fails or is bypassed, malformed messages can enter the inbox without any checks on structure, types, or content.
